title: Result appears after a delay
summary: After clicking "Load report" and waiting 2.5 seconds, the page shows "Report ready: 42 rows".
what_differs: The broken page shows "Report ready: 0 rows" once the delay passes.

wordings.text: Verify the page says "Report ready: 42 rows".
